sections.title: What it is
paragraphs: The orchestrator breaks a product spec into tickets. Coding agents build and test each one. A harness measures every stage, and a memory layer feeds lessons from past runs back in.

facts.caption: Starts at the product spec, one step before tickets.
Live agent demos for people outside engineering.

expanders.title: How it works
paragraphs: A product spec goes in. The orchestrator writes the tickets, and coding agents build and test each one. A test harness scores every stage, so when something goes wrong I can see where, and fix it.

expanders.title: What I tried
paragraphs: Starting the pipeline at the product spec instead of at tickets, so the agents see the intent and not just the task. A harness that scores every stage, so a failure points to where it happened.

expanders.title: What didn't work
paragraphs: Early on, the pipeline kept repeating the same mistakes. Measuring each stage showed where, and a memory layer that learns from past runs brought those failures down.

expanders.title: Teaching it
paragraphs: I run the company AI Academy: sessions with live demonstrations of agent workflows, so people outside engineering can use AI in their own work.
